en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: 1) To achieve mastery of basic knowledge and understanding of the principles and processes of genetics, genetic variability and gene function 2) To acquire the knowledge and skills of basic methods of genetic research and its applications 3) To gain intellectual skills to support the implementation of modern genetics and genomics innovation in biotechnological processes 4) To support the development of individual creative work.
